name: Iron Magma
look: a crouching robot Groudon of red armour veined with glowing magma, a navy belly, glowing ringed ports, a crown of red spikes over a glowing visor, navy back spikes and icy-blue crystal claws
entry: A Pokémon resembling Groudon, recorded in a report about a furnace that walked out of the Nether. Magma flows through the seams of its armour, and its crystal claws never melt.
how: Wild: very rare in the Nether's crimson forests and wastes.
